lines.text: quòd inimicus qui putabatur rebellis peteret securitatem &
lines.en: that the enemy who was thought to be rebellious would seek security and

lines.text: pacem, eò quòd Mercurius redibat ad Iouem, & ipse
lines.en: peace, because Mercury was returning to Jupiter, and he himself

lines.text: erat leuior harum duarum stellarum, ideóque
lines.en: was the lighter of these two stars, and therefore
was joined to Jupiter for this purpose
END OF THE BOOK OF MASHA'ALLAH

summary.headline: End of the Book on Reception
summary.text: Concluding astrological judgment that a rebellious enemy would seek security and peace because Mercury, the lighter star, was returning to Jupiter; marked as the end of Māshāʾallāh’s book on reception.
